features: Pact Tax: Free Action, once per round. Roll 1d6 + half your level (rounded down). Take that much True Damage and gain that many PP. The damage cannot be prevented, redirected, or reduced unless an effect says so, and it can drop you to 0 HP; you still gain the PP. When an item or feature lessens the damage, you still gain PP equal to the roll.
Bound Deeper: Advanced Pact Bonds unlocked (Level 3+)
Severed Reckoning: Expert Pact Bonds unlocked (Level 5+)
Effect dice: Bonds that deal dice of damage roll 1 extra die, once per use (weapon dice, Blight ticks and Grave Toll's bonus excluded; the Planewalker uses Channel the Beyond).
What Was Promised: your first Pact Tax each combat costs no HP; you still gain the PP. Pact Tax remains once per round; the Planewalker's Bleed-Through still permits one additional Tax as a Reaction.
Ultimate: your once-per-Long-Rest ability becomes its ultimate form (see your archetype).

passives: Bound Vessel: Both Pact Forms are available at Level 1. Entering a Form is a Bonus Action (0 PP); switching Forms is a Bonus Action and costs 2 PP.

Daemonsight: Sense the nearest Void, Daemonic or otherplanar creature within 60 ft. Your attacks against Void and Daemonic creatures ignore 2 DEF. Out of combat, you have Advantage on Strands checks to identify planar influence.
Spite Form: +2 DEF. Once per round, when you take damage, gain 3 PP. Reaction: when an enemy within 5 ft. of you attacks an ally, you become the target instead.
Wrath Form: +1d6 weapon damage. +10 ft. speed. Your Critical Hits happen on a natural 17–20.

abilities.name: Hellfire Blade
abilities.desc: Spend up to 15 PP: +1d8 Fire per 3 PP spent. Not reduced on a Glancing Blow.

abilities.name: Gorge
abilities.desc: Full Hit: recover HP equal to half the damage dealt.

abilities.name: Daemonic Leap
abilities.desc: Move up to 30 ft. in a straight line, ignoring difficult terrain and Opportunity Attacks.

abilities.name: Daemon Chains
abilities.desc: One enemy within 30 ft. makes a Fort Save or is Grappled until the start of its next turn.

abilities.name: The Leash Slips (Signature)
abilities.desc: Roll 1d6 — the result applies whether you like it or not. Every result costs you, never your allies. (1) Slaughter's Joy — Make three extra melee attacks this turn against enemies in reach. If none are in reach, first move up to 15 ft. toward the nearest. Each attack deals 1d6 backlash to you. (2) Pit-Born Dread — Every enemy within 20 ft. makes a Will Save or is Frightened of you until the end of its next turn. (3) Famine's End — Until the start of your next turn, damage you deal also heals you by the same amount. At the start of your next turn, lose half the HP you gained this way. (4) Borrowed Face — Choose an enemy within 30 ft. Until the end of your next turn, you have Advantage on attacks against it, and every other enemy has Advantage on attacks against you. (5) Overextended — Make one melee attack with 30 ft. reach. On a Full Hit, roll your weapon damage dice three times and add them. You are Staggered until the end of your next turn. (6) It Speaks — The GM tells you one true, useful thing about an enemy present, in the Daemon's voice. Then choose any other result on this table.

4.name: Daemonic Resilience
4.desc: Resistance to physical damage while in Spite Form.

7.name: Twin Forms
7.desc: When you switch Pact Forms, you keep the previous Form's benefits until the start of your next turn.

8.name: Hungering Binding
8.desc: Once per round, switching Pact Forms is a Free Action and costs 0 PP. When you switch, your next hit this turn deals +1d8.

10.name: The Leash Breaks (Ultimate)
10.desc: Choose a result from 1–5 instead of rolling, and the Daemon also speaks as in It Speaks. You enter Unbound Form for 3 rounds: both Pact Forms are active, your melee reach is +10 ft., and Pact Tax costs no HP.

passives: Heavy Vessel: Proficient with Heavy Armor, Shields, and all martial weapons. Your maximum HP increases by 2 per level.
Cold to the Touch: Resistance to Necrotic damage, and Advantage on saves against Frightened. Blight you apply is Cold and reduces the creature's speed by 10 ft.

Grave Toll: Track 0–6. Gain 1 Toll whenever you take damage, and 1 more when that damage is your own Pact Tax (2 per Tax). Toll resets to 0 when combat ends. At 3+ Toll your melee hits deal +1d6 Necrotic; at 6 they deal +2d6. Bonds with a Toll cost spend it, which can drop you below a threshold.

abilities.name: Soulrend Strike
abilities.desc: Add damage in steps. Each step costs 3 PP or 2 Grave Toll and adds +1d6 Necrotic. Maximum 5 steps (7 from Level 7). Full Hit: recover HP equal to half the Necrotic dealt by the steps.

abilities.name: Grave Strike
abilities.desc: Full Hit: recover HP equal to 1d8 + your level + your current Grave Toll.

abilities.name: Grave Pull
abilities.desc: One creature within 30 ft. makes a Fort Save or is pulled to a space adjacent to you. A Boss can't be pulled: instead, you move up to 30 ft. to a space adjacent to it without provoking (no save).

abilities.name: Spell Ward
abilities.desc: Until the start of your next turn: Resistance to damage from spells and magical effects, and Advantage on saves against them. Each time you succeed on such a save, gain 1 Grave Toll.

abilities.name: Debt Made Flesh (Signature)
abilities.desc: Requires 6 Grave Toll. Death does not gamble — it collects. Spend all your Grave Toll. Until the end of your turn, your melee attacks deal maximum damage and ignore DEF, your next Soulrend Strike gains 3 free steps (they count toward its maximum), and Grave Strike heals for the full damage dealt instead of its normal amount.

4.name: Unholy Resolve
4.desc: While you have 4+ Grave Toll, you have Resistance to physical damage.

7.name: Rime Eternal
7.desc: Blight you apply doesn't expire while the creature is within 30 ft. of you. Soulrend Strike's maximum rises to 7 steps.

8.name: Death's Patience
8.desc: Begin each combat with 3 Grave Toll. Once per round, when an ally within 10 ft. takes damage, gain 1 Grave Toll. While you have 3+ Toll, you can't be moved against your will.

10.name: Debt Comes Due (Ultimate)
10.desc: You may also use Debt Made Flesh as a Reaction when you drop to 0 HP, ignoring its Toll requirement: you drop to half your maximum HP instead, your Grave Toll is set to 6, and the maximum-damage turn happens on your next turn. When that turn starts, every Blight you have applied ticks at maximum.

passives: The Legion: Your Skeletons are counted, not tracked: the Legion Count is one number. When you first raise, place one Legion marker within 30 ft. of you. Once per turn you may move it up to 30 ft. (Free Action). The Legion Zone is every space within 10 ft. of the marker, and it is difficult terrain for enemies. Legion Cap: 3 at Level 1, 4 at Level 5, 6 at Level 8.
Losing Skeletons: An enemy can attack the Legion as if it were a creature with DEF 0 in the Legion Zone; any hit destroys 1 Skeleton. An area effect that includes the marker destroys 2 Skeletons.

Bone Satchel: You carry enough bone for a full Legion. Raise Bone Servant can draw on it instead of a corpse. When initiative is rolled and you aren't surprised, you may raise Skeletons up to your Legion Cap for 1 PP each (no action). The satchel refills on a Long Rest.
Bone Screen: While you are in the Legion Zone, the first weapon attack against you each round destroys a Skeleton instead of hitting you (twice per round from Level 8).
Death's Accountant: Once per round, when a creature dies in the Legion Zone, raise it as a Skeleton at no cost (up to your cap).

Bone Colossus (if learned): Hit Points: 10 × Skeletons consumed. DEF: 2 + half your level (rounded down). Speed: 30 ft. Reach 10 ft. Uses your saves.. Colossus Slam: Replaces Command Legion. Attack roll (PRES) against one creature within reach. Damage: 1 Legion die per Skeleton consumed + your PRES modifier. Legion Riders apply.. Bonus Action: Move it 30 ft., or it Shoves or Grapples a creature within reach (contested by your PRES).. Bodyguard (its Reaction): When an enemy within its reach attacks one of your allies, the Colossus becomes the target.. Duration: Until combat ends or it drops to 0 HP. Either way it collapses into bones: raise up to 2 Skeletons for free..

abilities.name: Raise Bone Servant
abilities.desc: +1 Skeleton (up to your cap), from a corpse within 30 ft. or from your Bone Satchel.

abilities.name: Command Legion
abilities.desc: Make one attack roll (PRES) against a creature in the Legion Zone. Damage: 1 die per Skeleton — d6, or d8 from Level 5. You may split the dice among up to 3 creatures in the zone. Glancing Blow: half. Legion Riders apply.

abilities.name: Withering Curse
abilities.desc: A creature within 30 ft. makes a Fort Save or gains 1 Blight (Necrotic), or 2 stacks if it is Bloodied.

abilities.name: Siphon
abilities.desc: Full Hit: recover HP equal to half the damage Command Legion dealt.

abilities.name: Ossuary Burst
abilities.desc: When a Skeleton is destroyed, or an enemy ends its turn in the Legion Zone: every enemy within 10 ft. of the marker makes a Ref Save or takes 2d8 Necrotic (success: half).

abilities.name: Mass Grave (Signature)
abilities.desc: Raise your Legion to its Cap from corpses within 60 ft. or your Bone Satchel. Your Command Legion this turn is an automatic Full Hit.

4.name: Endless Ranks
4.desc: Raise Bone Servant costs 2 PP, and Bone Satchel raises at combat start cost 0 PP.

7.name: Miasma of Decay
7.desc: Your Blight deals extra damage equal to half your level each time it ticks. Enemies in the Legion Zone with 2+ Blight stacks have −10 ft. speed.

8.name: Ossuary Lord
8.desc: Your Legion Cap becomes 6. Raise Bone Servant raises two Skeletons for its cost. Bone Screen works twice per round.

10.name: Ossuary Tide (Ultimate)
10.desc: Mass Grave raises your Legion to its Cap +3, whether or not corpses are present; the extra three crumble when combat ends. You may immediately form a Bone Colossus for 0 PP (it may use the extra Skeletons), and your next Command Legion or Colossus Slam this turn is an automatic Full Hit.

passives: Planar Echo: Passively sense active planar rifts, portals, or significant otherplanar influence within 60 ft.
Planar Mark: Your chosen plane grants a passive and a Signature Ability (see your plane).

Borrowed Strands: You know every Spell Form and pay for spells with PP. You know Channel the Beyond, Impose Minor Condition and Impose Major Condition. You can't learn Impose Severe Condition, and you can't hold a condition with Focused Sustain. Each Selection may be a Planar Bond or a Strand Augment from the Mind's Damage & Delivery, Control & Debuff, or Utility & Positioning lists (use your level for their gates).

Channel the Beyond: Your Destructive Augment: +2 PP per stack, dealing your plane's damage type. Each stack rolls 2d6 (3d6 from Level 9), and from Level 5 each spell rolls 1 extra die. Every die that rolls a 6 rolls again and adds (and keeps going on further 6s). These replace the Mind's per-stack effect dice.
Light Armor proficiency only — no Shield proficiency.

abilities.name: Glimpse Beyond
abilities.desc: A target within 30 ft. makes a Will Save or is Dazed until the end of its next turn. Either way, its next save against one of your Planar Bonds this combat is made at Disadvantage.

abilities.name: Step Between
abilities.desc: Teleport up to 20 ft. to a space you can see.

abilities.name: Bleed-Through
abilities.desc: When you take damage, use Pact Tax as a Reaction, generating PP from the same wound.

4.name: Deepening Mark
4.desc: Your Scaling Threat DC increases by 1. Once per round, when a creature fails a save against your spell or Planar Bond, gain 2 PP.

7.name: Echo Made Permanent
7.desc: Once per Short Rest, use a Planar Bond at no PP cost.

8.name: Fully Marked
8.desc: Choose one Planar Bond from a second plane, even without GM-granted access. You may change it on a Long Rest.

10.name: Plane Ultimate
10.desc: Fey — The Revel Unbound: Use it as a Reaction when you or an ally within 30 ft. fails a roll: that creature rerolls and takes either result. Until the end of your next turn, each ally within 30 ft. may do the same once. Void — The Seam Answers: Choose a result instead of rolling. You may then tear the Seam wider for a second, different result: the GM chooses it or rolls for it. Celestial — Choir Absolute: Target up to three enemies within 30 ft. Each makes a Will Save (Lieutenants and Bosses with Advantage) or is under your command for 1 round, then Staggered.

Fey.passive: Bound by Riddle: Once per Short Rest, when you answer a direct question, you may answer in a way that is technically true but deliberately misleading. The listener cannot detect this as deception by any mundane or magical means for the rest of the scene. At will, out of combat, you may also wear a minor glamour: change your hair, eyes, voice and clothing for the scene (purely cosmetic).

signatureAbility.name: The Revel's Wager
signatureAbility.desc: When you fail any roll, declare that it never happened. Reroll immediately and use the new result — no matter what it is, even if it's worse. The Fey are entertained either way.

Void.passive: Where Shadows Forget: While you are in dim light or darkness, the first attack made against you each combat is made at Disadvantage — the dark genuinely isn't sure where you are.

signatureAbility.name: Open the Seam
signatureAbility.desc: Tear a small, unstable rift into being at your feet. It does not ask permission. Roll 1d6 — the result applies immediately. Every result costs you, never your allies. (1) Hungry Maw — Enemies within 15 ft. make a Ref Save or are pulled 10 ft. toward the rift and take 3d6 Necrotic. You take 1d6. (2) Whispers Take Hold — Enemies within 20 ft. make a Will Save or must move toward the rift on their next turn. (3) Feeding Frenzy — This round you may use Pact Tax as a Free Action any number of times. Each use after the first deals an extra 1d6 to you. (4) Reality Bleeds — Until your next turn, any 1 or 2 rolled on damage dice by you or allies within 20 ft. counts as that die's maximum. (5) It Notices You — The rift gutters and something looks back. The GM privately notes that it now knows your name. Then choose any other result on this table. (6) Perfect Convergence — Until your next turn, your Void Bonds cost 0 PP and your spells ignore DEF.

Celestial.passive: Unblinking Witness: You always know, without rolling, when a creature within 30 ft. is directly lying to your face. You gain no special ability to act on this without revealing that you know.

signatureAbility.name: Choir of the Unseen
signatureAbility.desc: Choose one enemy within 30 ft. It makes a Will Save or comes under your absolute command for 1 round: you control its action, bonus action, and movement as if it were your own creature. At the end of that round it is Staggered, and it remembers exactly what you made it do.

basic.name: Leash-Cut
basic.desc: +2d6 damage. Full Hit: recover 2 PP.

basic.name: Smoldering Wound
basic.desc: Full Hit: apply 1 Blight (Fire).

basic.name: Daemon's Grasp
basic.desc: Full Hit: pull the target 5 ft.; it can't take Reactions until the start of its next turn.

basic.name: Brand of Torment
basic.desc: Mark an enemy within 30 ft. Your attacks against it deal +1d4 until combat ends.

basic.name: Daemon Rush
basic.desc: Dash 20 ft. through enemies' spaces; each enemy you pass through takes 2d4.

basic.name: Daemon's Bargain
basic.desc: Gain temporary HP equal to 5 + your level. At the start of your next turn, any that remain burst: each enemy within 5 ft. takes that much Fire.

basic.name: Searing Brand
basic.desc: An enemy within 30 ft. casts a spell: it takes 1d8 + half your level Fire, and your next attack against it has Advantage.

basic.name: Barbed Retort
basic.desc: When a melee attack damages you: the attacker takes half the damage you took (maximum 5 + your level).

advanced.name: Ruinous Blow
advanced.desc: Full Hit: double your weapon dice. A Bloodied Henchman hit this way dies.

advanced.name: Carnage
advanced.desc: After the hit, attack a different enemy within 5 ft. (no riders on the second attack).

advanced.name: Rending Strike
advanced.desc: Full Hit: −2 DEF until the end of its next turn. If it is Blighted, add 1 Blight stack.

advanced.name: Quarry's Scent
advanced.desc: Until your next turn: your speed doubles and you have Advantage on attacks against one chosen enemy.

advanced.name: Infernal Blast
advanced.desc: Every enemy within 15 ft. makes a Fort Save or takes 2d6 Fire and is Staggered (success: half damage, no condition).

advanced.name: Daemon's Gaze
advanced.desc: A 30 ft. line: Ref Save or 2d6 Fire and Dazed (success: half damage, no condition).

advanced.name: Infernal Engine
advanced.desc: In Wrath Form, if you damaged an enemy since your last turn, recover 2 PP at the start of your turn.

expert.name: Swallow the Will
expert.desc: Full Hit: Fort Save or Stunned until the end of its next turn.

expert.name: Executioner's Mark
expert.desc: Full Hit against a Bloodied target: +3d8. If it dies, recover 4 PP.

expert.name: Daemonic Trample
expert.desc: Move 20 ft. in a straight line; each enemy in your path makes a Ref Save or takes 2d8 and falls Prone (success: half, no condition).

expert.name: Abyssal Counter
expert.desc: When a melee attack hits you: attack the attacker. Full Hit: Staggered.

expert.name: Unending Hatred
expert.desc: When an enemy dies within 30 ft., recover 4 PP, and your next attack before the end of your next turn has Advantage.

expert.name: Abyssal Frenzy
expert.desc: Make three melee attacks. On-Hit Riders apply to one of them.

basic.name: Rime Blight
basic.desc: Full Hit: apply 1 Blight (Cold; slows 10 ft.).

basic.name: Frostbite Edge
basic.desc: +1d8 Cold. If the target is Blighted, +2d8 instead.

basic.name: Marked for the Grave
basic.desc: Mark an enemy within 30 ft. until combat ends. Your hits against it deal +1d6. The first time each round an ally damages it, gain 1 Grave Toll.

basic.name: Fetters of Rime
basic.desc: One enemy within 30 ft. makes a Fort Save or is Restrained until the end of its next turn.

basic.name: Ledger's Guard
basic.desc: When you take damage: spend any Grave Toll to reduce that damage by 2 per Toll spent (after DEF).

basic.name: Toll the Bell
basic.desc: An enemy within 10 ft. hits an ally: it takes 1d10 + half your level Necrotic and has Disadvantage on attacks against anyone but you until the end of its next turn.

basic.name: Blood for the Ledger
basic.desc: Once per turn, convert 3 PP into 2 Grave Toll.

basic.name: Bonebreaker
basic.desc: Once per turn, your melee hits deal +1d6 against a creature whose speed is reduced (Slowed, Grappled, Restrained, Rooted, or slowed by your Blight).

advanced.name: Deep Rot
advanced.desc: Full Hit: apply 2 Blight stacks.

advanced.name: Settle the Account
advanced.desc: Full Hit: double your weapon dice, and recover HP equal to half the damage dealt.

advanced.name: Spreading Rime
advanced.desc: Choose a Blighted enemy within 30 ft.: every other enemy within 10 ft. of it gains Blight with the same number of stacks.

advanced.name: Hoarfrost Burst
advanced.desc: Each Blighted enemy within 10 ft. of you takes 1d8 Cold, and its Blight rises to 3 stacks.

advanced.name: Deathless March
advanced.desc: Until your next turn: +10 ft. speed, ignore difficult terrain, and immunity to forced movement and Grappled.

advanced.name: Ledger Leeches
advanced.desc: At the start of each of your next 3 turns, recover 1d6 + half your level HP.

advanced.name: Death's Counter
advanced.desc: When a melee attack hits you: attack the attacker. Full Hit: Staggered.

expert.name: Frozen Solid
expert.desc: Full Hit: Fort Save or Paralyzed until the end of its next turn.

expert.name: Reaping Toll
expert.desc: Full Hit against a Bloodied target: at the start of your next turn it takes 4d6 Necrotic (ignores DEF), and you recover HP equal to the damage.

expert.name: Shatter the Rot
expert.desc: +2d8 damage, plus 1d8 per Blight stack on the target. The Blight remains.

expert.name: Killing Frost
expert.desc: Every enemy within 15 ft. makes a Fort Save or takes 2d6 Cold and gains 1 Blight (success: half damage, no Blight).

expert.name: Foreclosure
expert.desc: Every enemy within 10 ft. makes a Fort Save or takes 3d8 Necrotic and is Frightened of you (success: half damage, no condition).

expert.name: Final Notice
expert.desc: An ally within 30 ft. would drop to 0 HP: they drop to 1 HP instead, and you take the excess damage as True Damage (gaining Toll as normal).

expert.name: Harvester's Presence
expert.desc: Enemies within 10 ft. of you can't regain HP.

basic.name: Grasping Dead
basic.desc: Full Hit: the target is Grappled until the start of its next turn.

basic.name: Festering Wound
basic.desc: Full Hit: apply 1 Blight (Necrotic).

basic.name: Bone Shrapnel
basic.desc: Full Hit: every other enemy in the Legion Zone takes 1d6 Piercing.

basic.name: Bone Armor
basic.desc: Gain temporary HP equal to 1d6 + your PRES modifier + half your level.

basic.name: Echoing Wail
basic.desc: Every enemy in the Legion Zone makes a Will Save or is Frightened until the end of its next turn.

basic.name: Bone Ward
basic.desc: You or an ally in or adjacent to the Legion Zone takes damage: destroy 1 Skeleton and either reduce that damage by 1d8 + your level, or have the creature recover that much HP after the hit.

basic.name: Marrow Feast
basic.desc: The first time a Skeleton is destroyed each round, recover PP equal to 2 + half your level.

advanced.name: Rattling Charge
advanced.desc: Move the Legion marker up to 30 ft.; every enemy in its new Legion Zone makes a Ref Save or falls Prone.

advanced.name: Plague Spread
advanced.desc: Full Hit on a Blighted creature: every other enemy in the Legion Zone gains Blight with the same number of stacks.

advanced.name: Unfailing Command
advanced.desc: Your Command Legion (or Colossus Slam) this turn is an automatic Full Hit.

advanced.name: Soul Lance
advanced.desc: A 30 ft. ranged attack: 2d8 Necrotic (half on a Glancing Blow), or an ally within 30 ft. recovers 2d8 HP instead.

advanced.name: Ossuary Span
advanced.desc: Per Skeleton spent, raise a 5 ft. section of bone wall, bridge or platform within 30 ft. Each section has 5 × your level HP.

advanced.name: Bone Colossus
advanced.desc: Fuse your Legion (minimum 3 Skeletons) into a Bone Colossus. See the stat block. Hit Points: 10 × Skeletons consumed. DEF: 2 + half your level (rounded down). Speed: 30 ft. Reach 10 ft. Uses your saves. Colossus Slam: Replaces Command Legion. Attack roll (PRES) against one creature within reach. Damage: 1 Legion die per Skeleton consumed + your PRES modifier. Legion Riders apply. Bonus Action: Move it 30 ft., or it Shoves or Grapples a creature within reach (contested by your PRES). Bodyguard (its Reaction): When an enemy within its reach attacks one of your allies, the Colossus becomes the target. Duration: Until combat ends or it drops to 0 HP. Either way it collapses into bones: raise up to 2 Skeletons for free.

advanced.name: Plague of the Grave
advanced.desc: Every enemy in the Legion Zone makes a Fort Save or is Poisoned until the end of its next turn.

expert.name: Paralytic Rot
expert.desc: Full Hit: Fort Save or Paralyzed until the end of its next turn.

expert.name: Legion's Wrath
expert.desc: Command Legion (or Colossus Slam) rolls 3 extra Legion dice.

expert.name: Necrotic Presence
expert.desc: Each enemy in the Legion Zone makes its first save each round against your Bonds at Disadvantage.

expert.name: Last Rites
expert.desc: Once per combat, when damage would drop you to 0 HP: destroy 3 Skeletons and drop to 1 HP instead.

expert.name: Harvest of Souls
expert.desc: Per Skeleton destroyed: recover 4 PP, or you or an ally within 30 ft. recovers 1d8 + half your level HP.

basic.name: Wild Bargain
basic.desc: A target within 30 ft. makes a Will Save; on a failure, roll 1d4: (1) Frightened, (2) Slowed, (3) you gain +10 ft. speed instead, (4) roll again and apply the result to the target and one more enemy within 30 ft. A second 4 has no further effect.

basic.name: Thorned Glamour
basic.desc: An enemy within 30 ft. makes a Will Save or, on its next turn, attacks the creature nearest to it (ally or enemy) instead of acting normally.

basic.name: Stolen Step
basic.desc: Swap positions with a creature within 30 ft. An unwilling creature makes a Will Save to negate.

basic.name: Will-o'-Light
basic.desc: A target within 30 ft. is outlined in light until the end of your next turn: attacks against it have Advantage, and it can't benefit from Invisible or Hidden.

basic.name: Capricious Step
basic.desc: When you are hit, teleport 10 ft. If you are no longer in the attack's reach or area, it deals no damage.

advanced.name: Revel's Edge
advanced.desc: Once per round, when a Critical Hit happens within 30 ft. (anyone's), or one of your Channel the Beyond dice rolls again twice in a row, recover 3 PP.

advanced.name: Fair Exchange
advanced.desc: An enemy within 30 ft. makes a Will Save. On a failure, every condition affecting you moves to it, lasting until the end of its next turn. If you had no conditions, it has Disadvantage on its next attack instead.

advanced.name: Tithe to the Hollow Hill
advanced.desc: An ally within 30 ft. gains temporary HP equal to 5 + your level. If any remain at the start of their next turn, it bursts into thorns: each enemy within 5 ft. of them takes that much Psychic.

expert.name: Unmaking Jest
expert.desc: A target within 30 ft. makes a Will Save or is Stunned until the end of its next turn, helpless with laughter.

expert.name: The Court's Whim
expert.desc: A target within 30 ft. makes a Will Save. On a failure, roll 1d4: (1) Paralyzed until the end of its next turn, (2) teleported 30 ft. in a random direction, (3) Restrained by briars until the end of its next turn, (4) it loses its next turn.

basic.name: Hollow Touch
basic.desc: Add to a weapon attack or a one-target spell. Full Hit: +1d8 Necrotic, and the target's HP maximum is reduced by the same amount (until it dies or takes a Long Rest).

basic.name: Null Touch
basic.desc: A creature within 30 ft. would regain HP: it regains half (a Will Save negates).

basic.name: Void Whisper
basic.desc: A creature within 30 ft. that can hear you is Off-Guard against Will: its next Will Save before your next turn is made at Disadvantage.

basic.name: Lightless Step
basic.desc: When you are targeted while in dim light or darkness, teleport 15 ft. to another dim or dark space; the attack has Disadvantage.

advanced.name: Unraveling
advanced.desc: A target within 30 ft. makes a Will Save or loses 1 DEF at the start of each of its turns (stacks to −3) until combat ends.

advanced.name: Devourer's Patience
advanced.desc: A creature within 30 ft. becomes Bloodied: it takes 2d8 + half your level Necrotic, and you recover half that much HP.

expert.name: Collapse the Self
expert.desc: A target within 30 ft. makes a Will Save or is Paralyzed until the end of its next turn.

expert.name: Swallowed Word
expert.desc: A Lieutenant or Boss within 60 ft. uses a Legendary Action or a Reaction: it makes a Will Save or that action is wasted (it is still spent).

expert.name: Starving Rift
expert.desc: Until the end of your next turn, your Channel the Beyond dice roll again on a 5 or 6, and you gain 1 PP for each re-roll (up to 6 PP per spell).

basic.name: Verdict
basic.desc: Declare a compulsion on an enemy within 30 ft. ("you will not attack my ally"). If it breaks the compulsion before your next turn, it takes 2d8 + half your level Radiant immediately (no save).

basic.name: Compelling Gaze
basic.desc: An enemy within 30 ft. makes a Will Save or its next attack targets a creature of your choice (ally or enemy).

basic.name: Judging Light
basic.desc: A 20 ft. radius fills with harsh light for 1 round. Enemies in it can't benefit from Hidden or Invisible.

basic.name: Weight of Conscience
basic.desc: An enemy within 30 ft. makes a Will Save or has Disadvantage on its next attack roll.

advanced.name: Deferred Judgment
advanced.desc: Mark an enemy. The next time it harms one of your allies, it takes 3d8 Radiant as delayed judgment. Lasts until triggered or combat ends.

advanced.name: Wings of Judgment
advanced.desc: Fly speed 30 ft. until the end of your next turn. Your first attack against a creature below you has Advantage.

expert.name: Final Sentence
expert.desc: A 30 ft. ranged attack: 2d8 Radiant (half on a Glancing Blow). Full Hit: Will Save or Stunned until the end of its next turn.

expert.name: The Court Convenes
expert.desc: Up to 3 chosen enemies within 30 ft. each make a Will Save or are Restrained by radiant chains until the end of their next turn.

expert.name: Pillar of Judgment
expert.desc: A 10 ft. radius at a point within 60 ft.: enemies take 4d8 Radiant (Ref half); allies in the area recover 1d8 HP.
